messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: SDK 2.5.0 -> canary (streaming/paging protocol changes enabled). sha: abc123. Rollout: 5% canary

maria: seeing spike in streaming handshake errors from canary metrics — 502/handshake-timeout up ~4.2% at 12:46 UTC

jonathan: tagging oncall — @sachin are you available?

sachin (oncall): I’m on it, pulling logs now

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2067890123 - SDK canary streaming handshake errors (pager: sachin)

maria: logs show client handshake: `ERR_FRAME_UNEXPECTED` and `handshake: unsupported protocol v2` when client is 2.5.0. Server seems to expect v1 frames. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:46:02Z | conn=abcd | recv frame header: version=2
2026-03-15T12:46:02Z | conn=abcd | ERR_FRAME_UNEXPECTED: expected version=1
```

tilly (eng-sre): do we know if this is client-side only or gateway/runtime change? canary was supposed to be backwards-compatible

maria: repro'd locally by running SDK 2.5.0 against prod-ish runtime -> handshake fails. Downgrading client to 2.4.2 succeeds immediately

jonathan (devex): support — any customer reports? severity?

ana typo? no — ana (support): Three customers reported: AcmeCorp (stream disconnects), BrightPay (partial responses), Learnly (timeout spikes). All on streaming endpoints. Marked P2 and opened tickets.

sachin (oncall): since this is causing customer impact on canary, initiating feature-flag kill for `client_streaming_v2` on canary now: `redwood feature kill client_streaming_v2 --env=canary`

ops-bot: Feature flag kill confirmed for `client_streaming_v2` on canary at 12:49 UTC

maria: after kill: handshake failures on canary dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. Looks like the SDK change enabled a new protocol frame that runtime didn't accept

sachin (oncall): rolling back canary SDK to 2.4.2: `ci-deploy rollback --service=sdk --to=2.4.2 --target=canary`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for sdk on canary; monitoring 95th latency and handshake error rate

tilly (eng-sre): I'll watch infra for any capacity regressions during rollback — watching 95th latency and connection churn

jonathan (devex): we need a hotfix path to restore backwards compatibility and a clear rollback/upgrade checklist. assigning to maria + eng-runtime

maria: working on a compatibility shim to accept both v1 and v2 handshake frames. PR created: `git/pulls/4567`. Running e2e with legacy clients now

ana? no — ana (support): updated affected customers with mitigation (downgrade SDK or server-side kill) and ETA for patch. Tickets linked to the incident.

sachin (oncall): adding on-call notes and will hand off to tilly in ~40m. keeping pager open until patch validated

ops-bot: Incident INC-2067890123 severity downgraded to P3 after rollback + kill-switch mitigation

maria: deploying compatibility patch to canary in ~15m. will run streaming e2e (legacy + new client) and then lift kill if green

jonathan (devex): postmortem action items:
- add integration test matrix covering SDK versions vs runtime handshake
- add deployment gate to block canary rollouts that change handshake protocol without backward-compat flag

tilly (eng-sre): also add an automated canary health check: handshake error rate > 0.5% for > 1m -> auto-kill flag and rollback

ana? again — ana (support): following up with customers to confirm they can downgrade or accept server-side mitigation; offering priority support until patch is validated

sachin (oncall): plan: close incident after 2h of stable canary post-patch and no new customer regressions. handoff to tilly in 40m

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2067890123 CLOSED at 13:20 UTC — summary: SDK 2.5.0 introduced streaming handshake incompatibility causing transient customer impact on canary; mitigated via feature-flag kill + rollback; compatibility patch in progress and e2e verification underway.

maria: final note — we're updating the SDK release notes to include explicit runtime handshake contract and adding a pre-release matrix test for future version bumps
